shortDescription: Fermi NASDAQ:FRMI  signed a management agreement with CBRE Group NYSE:CBRE to run and maintain building one, its first data center in the Texas Panhandle, the company said Thursday.The contract runs for five years starting the first day that the building is ready for service. children: to run and maintain building one, its first data center in the Texas Panhandle, the company said Thursday.
The contract runs for five years starting the first day that the building is ready for service. Fermi
can renew the agreement in five-year terms.

"CBRE runs some of the most demanding data center environments in the world," said Fermi CEO Lee McIntire. "Bringing them in now means that when building one is ready for service, the people, the programs, and the procedures to run it are already in place."
Building one is part of Fermi's Project Matador near Amarillo, Texas. As new buildings come online, Fermi can add them under the same framework.
This month, the first turbines arrived on the site. In August, Fermi
signed a binding lease with TensorWave, its first customer, and formed an alliance with Hillcore Energy Capital for ~2.6 GW of added power.

title: CBRE gets contract to operate and maintain Fermi's first data center
